card.name: Partway through words and "per 100" figures
card.fires_on: Mid-word pieces such as "enn" in decennia and quinquennial, and the zero in "mg/100 mL" or "/100PY" after a slash and 10 or 1. Also "unit" after "per" and "tip" in tipranavir.

modes.label: Zero in per-100 rates
modes.description: The zero digit completing 100 in a denominator, as in creatinine clearance formulas or event rates.

modes.label: Inside "-ennial" words
modes.description: The piece "enn" inside decennia or quinquennial, words for spans of years.

modes.label: Other word starts after per or and
modes.description: A word or drug-name piece in a list or ratio phrase, such as "unit" after per or "tip" before ranavir.

card.plain: It fires on a few unrelated spots: the zero in 100 in a kidney formula, and the middle of rare words like quinquennial.
